items.quote: God, before whom my fathers Abraham and Isaac did walk
items.claim: Abraham and Isaac walked before God

items.quote: the God which fed me all my life long unto this day
items.claim: God provided sustenance to Jacob throughout his life

items.quote: The Angel which redeemed me from all evil
items.claim: An Angel redeemed Jacob from all evil

items.quote: The Angel which redeemed me from all evil, bless the lads
let my name be named on them, and the name of my fathers Abraham and Isaac
items.claim: Jacob's and his fathers' names should be perpetuated in Joseph's sons
items.object: my name... and the name of my fathers Abraham and Isaac

items.quote: let them grow into a multitude in the midst of the earth
items.claim: Joseph's sons should multiply and populate the earth
items.place: in the midst of the earth
